SELECT c.id, c.name AS title, NULL AS subtitle, i.name AS instructor, c.cover_url AS image, c.rating, c.review_count AS reviewCount, COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) AS learnedSections, COUNT(cs.id) AS total_sections, CASE WHEN COUNT(cs.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) * 100 / COUNT(cs.id)) END AS progress, CASE ll.status WHEN 1 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN 2 THEN 'COMPLETED' END AS status, ll.latest_section_id AS latestSectionId FROM course c JOIN learning_lesson ll ON c.id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN category ca ON c.category_id = ca.id LEFT JOIN course_section cs ON c.id = cs.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1
AND ll.status = 1
AND ll.status = 2
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, i.name, c.cover_url, c.rating, c.review_count, ll.learned_sections, ll.status, ll.latest_section_id, ll.latest_learn_time, ll.update_time ORDER BY ll.latest_learn_time DESC, ll.update_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c JOIN learning_lesson ll ON c.id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN category ca ON c.category_id = ca.id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND ll.status = 1

SELECT ca.name, ca.icon, COUNT(*) AS count FROM course c JOIN learning_lesson ll ON c.id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN category ca ON c.category_id = ca.id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 GROUP BY ca.id, ca.name, ca.icon ORDER BY ca.name
